spokenMeaning: Repeating 'yes' for everyone drains its value until the word becomes noise with no meaning left.
viewerTakeaway: Watch the one sincere YES get copied into a grid for everyone, lose its privilege, and join the crowd while its teal value line retracts to a stub.
visualMechanism: singular word diluted into crowd grid

visualNarrative.action: Headline 'YOUR YES STOPS MEANING ANYTHING' fades up left; one large crisp YES sits right with a full-width teal value line drawing beneath it; a dim row of audience dots waits along the bottom.
visualNarrative.meaning: The first yes serves one asker and carries full credibility.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Left headline + subtitle band, right oversized sharp YES, edge-to-edge teal line, faint audience dot row, ~65% empty dark space.

visualNarrative.action: Three smaller dim YES copies fan out beside the hero at 0.45s; the teal line retracts to two-thirds width in the same frame.
visualNarrative.meaning: Saying it again to more people already costs measurable value.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Hero YES still dominant but now flanked by 3 reduced, dimmer echoes; teal line visibly shorter the moment they land.

visualNarrative.action: Echoes multiply into a compact grid of identical dim YES marks at 0.75s; the teal line retracts to a short stub; the audience dots lift once in applause and settle.
visualNarrative.meaning: Quantity turns the answer into interchangeable texture for everyone asked.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Uniform grid of six equal YES cells, short teal stub beneath the hero position, one restrained pulse of the dot row.

visualNarrative.action: At 1.05s the hero YES scales down and slides into the one empty grid cell, matching the others in size and brightness; the stub holds.
visualNarrative.meaning: The singular answer joins the crowd — its privilege and identity erode.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: No YES is larger than any other after the merge; grid complete; teal stub unchanged and diminished.

visualNarrative.action: Frame settles static with soft ease-out: uniform dim grid, teal stub, headline and subtitle still perfectly legible.
visualNarrative.meaning: Hollowness — the word survives, the value underneath it is gone; the emotional low point.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Equalized YES grid, short stub, one crisp headline, one subtitle line, heavy negative space.

compositionIntent: leftTextRightObject: headline top-left with subtitle in the bottom-left band; hero YES and its echo grid fill the right column over one teal value line; audience dots run along the bottom-right baseline. No caption label anywhere. ~65% empty dark; only the right column is lit action.
visualEvidence: One large YES shrinks into a uniform grid of identical dim copies — privilege lost by quantity alone.
Teal value line measurably shortens with each multiplication and ends as a short stub.
Audience dot row gives exactly one restrained applause pulse, then stays dim.
forbiddenInterpretations: No side caption such as 'THREE ANSWERS. ONE VOICE.' — any extra label collides with the headline anchor.
No blur or semantic-satiation dissolve — that decay path was used in the previous version.
No strike-throughs, crossed-out words, droplets, cracks or particles; decay stays geometric and typographic.
No glowing or red-warning treatment; teal is the only accent, no second accent word.
No evenly spaced YES copies before the grid forms — echoes must visibly shrink and dim toward equality, max nine instances.
noveltyIntent: Value dies by equalization, not by blur: the one sincere YES is copied for everyone, the copies mass into a grid, the teal meter retracts to a stub, and the hero itself scales down and merges into the last cell — the answer survives only as one indistinguishable cell among many.
